name: nonApi_refreshEventActivity
description: Recomputes the four activity counts kept on HC.Event for the run cards — TrackRunnerCount (HasherEventMap rows, removed = 0, with TrackPointCount > 0), PhotoCount (HC.KennelPhotos with DeletedAt NULL and Status >= 2, i.e. approved), MessageCount (HC.EventMessage with Removed = 0), DownDownCount (HC.DownDowns with IsCancelled = 0) — and writes them ONLY when one differs. The write stamps updatedAt through the Event trigger, so the row syncs to every follower's phone; the guard keeps a live run (a PackTrack batch a minute per runner) from re-syncing the row for nothing. Called by the triggers on HC.HasherEventMap, HC.KennelPhotos, HC.EventMessage and HC.DownDowns, so every writer — SP or API — keeps the counts right without knowing about them (CLAUDE.md 'Run-card data is synced, never fetched while scrolling'; E5.F7.S1). The definitions match hcapp_getRunActivity 1.1.0 except photos: the card's count is the approved photos everyone may see, not the viewer's own pending ones. Internal; no auth. Returns nothing; a runtime error is logged to HC.ErrorLog (eventId recorded) and re-thrown — into the calling trigger, which then fails the triggering write.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The run to recount. NULL or unknown ⇒ no rows match ⇒ no-op.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Event SET TrackRunnerCount, PhotoCount, MessageCount, DownDownCount WHERE id = @eventId AND at least one differs — fires the Event updatedAt trigger, so the run re-syncs.
Reads HC.HasherEventMap, HC.KennelPhotos, HC.EventMessage, HC.DownDowns (four correlated COUNTs).
On any runtime error: rolls back if a transaction is open, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<unknown>', eventId = @eventId), then THROWs.

codeSmells.detail: @eventId has no SQL default. Called only from the four table triggers, which always pass it. A call that omits one fails before the body runs — no HC.ErrorLog row, no graceful check (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default').

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
